transcript: Pass an egg over your entire body from head to toe and remove all the negative energy you carry. Tomorrow when you wake up you will understand why. This is one of the oldest energy cleansing practices that exist. It has been used for centuries and it works just as well today. All you need is an egg, a glass filled halfway with water and a pinch of fine salt. Hold the egg with both hands, close your eyes and say quietly, absorb everything I carry that does not belong to me. You are giving it an order. You are telling the egg what it needs to do for you. Now pass it slowly from the crown of your head down to your feet over your forehead, the back of your neck, your shoulders, your chest, your belly, your legs. Take your time, no rush. Once it reaches your feet do not bring it back up. The energy goes down and out. It must not return. If you can do it without clothes even better, that way the egg works directly on your skin. When you finish, crack the egg into the glass of water and add the pinch of salt. Wait a few seconds and look from the side, never from above. If you see bubbles around the yolk, your body was overloaded with energy. If you see white spikes rising like needles, there is an evil eye. Someone is sending you envy or draining your energy. If the yolk stays at the bottom, the egg did its job well. If it rises or stays in the middle, there is something deeper acting on you. When you're done, flush it down the toilet without looking at it from above. Do this whenever you feel heavy, stuck in a bad streak or with the feeling that something is not right. And do not be afraid of what comes out in the glass. Be afraid of how long you have been carrying all of that without doing anything about it. Not all exhaustion comes from the body. Sometimes what weighs you down cannot be seen, but it can be felt. Write in the comments I cleanse. If you're going to do this tonight and come back to tell me what you found, and if you feel that it is not just a cleansing you need, but that you need to learn how to protect your energy every day and release everything you carry inside. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
